oracle-l5r-10358.note: A Cleansing Breath (Strategy, issue #736): "Battle/Open: Target your Personality at any location. He centers himself. Negate other players' cards' effects that prevent him assigning, moving or performing actions. If he is a Kensai, straighten his unit." The negations are P12 Prevention and movement/assignment immunities, but "he centers himself" has no definition anywhere in the repository (core rules, rulings or code): it names a rule the owner has not given. Needs Mendon's ruling on what centering does before the card is built; publishing it without the sentence would drop printed text.

oracle-l5r-10473.note: Asako Kaitoko - exp (Personality, issue #736): "Personalities with Fallen, Kolat, Ninja, Nonhuman, or Shadowlands opposing Kaitoko have a maximum Force of 3, and actions from cards in their units may not target Kaitoko." Two gaps: a maximum Force is a stat cap and none exists (P9 left StatCap out; PersonalityForce is additive, so a cap cannot be written without reading the Force it caps), and the target bar applies only to actors whose Personality has one of five keywords, which an ActorSpec cannot say.

oracle-l5r-10476.note: Isawa Ryuzo (Personality, issue #736): "Fire Open: Target two Personalities, each with more Madness tokens than printed Personal Honor. They will not attack or defend in the same army." P11's pair restriction (NoPair) stops two cards sharing a battlefield on either side, which is stricter than the printed same-army rule (they may stand opposed at one battlefield); a same-side pair restriction is needed. Entry Honor loss and the Madness-token comparison are available.

oracle-l5r-10497.note: P'an Ku - exp (Personality, issue #736): "Open, bow: Give a target card a Madness token" is built (the existing panku-madness shape). "Limited, bow: P'an Ku may remain bowed. Take control of a target Personality with more Madness tokens than printed Personal Honor and remove those tokens. The target will not commit seppuku until P'an Ku straightens or leaves play. After P'an Ku does, give control of the target to his owner." Most of this is merged: the timed return of control is P24's ReturnControlWhenSourceStraightens (ControlReturnTriggers.SourceStraightens, EffectPrimitivesTokens.cs, built for this card: docs/decisions/2026-10-06-690-p24-effect-primitives.md section 8), and "may remain bowed" is the existing choose-straighten Effect (Constructing the Self uses it in batch 10). The remaining gap is the seppuku bar: no P11 restriction kind bars seppuku, and P5's SeppukuBar (EmperorP5Zones.cs) lasts one turn, so "will not commit seppuku until P'an Ku straightens or leaves play" needs a bar bound to a source card. His Effect slot must also carry choose-straighten alongside his other abilities.

oracle-l5r-10524.note: Koan's Jingasa (Item, issue #736): "This Personality has Shugenja, may not have more Spells than Koan cards attached, and he need not bow for his Spells with an odd Focus Value (0 is even)." The Shugenja keyword is AttachGrantsKeyword, and the bow waiver is merged: P24's EngineHooks.CostWaivers with SpellFocusParityWaives (EffectPrimitivesCosts.cs) is written for this card and Koan's Robes, and a wave registers the callback with the Item's Effect. What is still missing is the attachment limit: P11's SpellLimit counts Spell actions performed, not Spells attached, and NoAttach bars by type or keyword without counting, so "may not have more Spells than Koan cards attached" (a count of Koan cards on the host against his attached Spells) needs a new attach rule.

oracle-l5r-10831.note: Hida Kaiji - exp (Personality, issue #736): "Will not attack or defend with other Personalities, and other Personalities will not attack or defend with Kaiji. Kaiji has +2F while unopposed, or +1F for each Personality opposing him with 6 or lower printed Force." The Force terms are available (a PersonalityForce hook), but the first sentence is an assignment rule over the whole army (Kaiji alone in his army, and no army that holds him holds another Personality); P11's pair restriction judges every card at the battlefield on both sides, so it would also bar him from being opposed.

oracle-l5r-10364.note: Bonds of Hospitality (Strategy, issue #736): "Limited: Target a bowed Personality: Put this card into play. While this card remains in play, negate the target's straightening, and his controller has the ability, 'Open: Pay 4 Gold: Discard a Bonds of Hospitality.'" Wirable now on merged pieces; the gaps first noted are closed. A straighten bar that lasts while a card is in play is StraightenHold.WhileInPlay (StraightenHolds.cs names this card). The player-level ability is P4's GrantPlayerAbility(..., whileInPlay: the card's id) (docs/decisions/2026-10-06-690-p4-turn-boundary.md lists this card), and a PlayerAbility that costs Gold and discards a card by title is the Fortress of Lidless Eyes shape (fortress-lidless-destroy). A Strategy that stays in play exists (the Kata, Economic Repercussions, The Bite of Winter). The pieces have not been exercised together for this card, so build and test them as a unit.
